zh.title: 易斯達航空攜手NMIXX推出聯名彩繪機　HL8717預計11月起投入營運
zh.summary: 易斯達航空與NMIXX推出聯名企劃，將以HL8717波音737-8打造大型彩繪機，預計自2026年11月11日起營運至2027年4月30日。
body: 韓國低成本航空公司易斯達航空（Eastar Jet）宣布與JYP Entertainment旗下女子團體NMIXX展開聯名合作，並將推出以NMIXX成員形象為主題的彩繪客機。此次聯名彩繪機將使用註冊編號HL8717的Boeing 737-8（737 MAX 8），預計自2026年11月11日起投入營運，規劃運行至2027年4月30日。
易斯達航空此次與NMIXX的合作不僅涵蓋機身彩繪，也延伸至旅客搭機過程。航空公司自10月2日起陸續推出NMIXX主題國際線登機證，韓國出發航班的紙本登機證將採用團體概念照，海外出發返回韓國的部分航班則會於行動登機證隨機顯示成員照片及親筆訊息。
在客艙方面，包括HL8717在內的部分易斯達航空客機將使用NMIXX專輯主題的座椅頭枕套；自10月20日起，相關航班亦規劃播放由成員錄製的問候語及歌曲。HL8717則是此次合作中唯一規劃於機身外觀加入NMIXX成員圖像的大型聯名彩繪機，預計自11月11日起正式開始彩繪機營運。
HL8717為易斯達航空旗下Boeing 737-8客機。航班追蹤資料顯示，該機目前持續投入易斯達航空的國際線營運，近期曾執飛臺北、東京、福岡、香港及富國島等航點。聯名彩繪完成後，原則上仍將依航空公司的機隊調度執飛不同航線，並非固定配置於單一目的地，因此實際可搭乘彩繪機的航班仍須依當日派遣情況而定。
NMIXX目前由Lily、Haewon、Sullyoon、Bae、Jiwoo與Kyujin六名成員組成。易斯達航空表示，此次合作將配合NMIXX新作品宣傳，並鎖定日本、臺灣等具有海外粉絲基礎的市場，透過登機證、機艙內容及彩繪客機等方式，將娛樂內容融入旅客的搭機體驗。
依目前公布的規劃，NMIXX聯名彩繪機HL8717預計營運至2027年4月30日；相關聯名內容的實際執行日期及航班安排，仍可能依易斯達航空後續營運與機隊調度調整。

en.title: Eastar Jet Teams Up With NMIXX for Special Livery, HL8717 Set to Enter Service in November
en.summary: Eastar Jet is launching an NMIXX collaboration featuring Boeing 737-8 HL8717 in a special livery, with operations planned from November 11, 2026 through April 30, 2027.
body: South Korean low-cost carrier Eastar Jet has announced a collaboration with JYP Entertainment girl group NMIXX, including a special aircraft livery featuring the group's members. The promotional aircraft will be Boeing 737-8 (737 MAX 8) HL8717, with service scheduled to begin on November 11, 2026 and continue through April 30, 2027.

The Eastar Jet–NMIXX collaboration extends beyond the exterior livery to the passenger journey. From October 2, the airline began rolling out NMIXX-themed international boarding passes. Paper boarding passes for flights departing South Korea feature group concept images, while selected mobile boarding passes for overseas departures back to South Korea randomly display member photos and handwritten messages.

Inside the cabin, selected Eastar Jet aircraft including HL8717 will use seat headrest covers themed around NMIXX album artwork. From October 20, relevant flights are also scheduled to play greetings and songs recorded by the members. HL8717 is the only aircraft in the campaign planned to carry large-scale exterior images of NMIXX members, with the special-livery aircraft scheduled to enter service from November 11.

HL8717 is a Boeing 737-8 in Eastar Jet's fleet. Flight-tracking data shows that the aircraft remains active on the airline's international network and has recently operated to destinations including Taipei, Tokyo, Fukuoka, Hong Kong and Phu Quoc. After the special livery is applied, the aircraft is expected to continue operating across different routes according to fleet scheduling rather than being assigned to a single destination, meaning actual opportunities to fly on the aircraft will depend on daily dispatch decisions.

NMIXX currently consists of six members: Lily, Haewon, Sullyoon, Bae, Jiwoo and Kyujin. Eastar Jet said the collaboration is intended to support promotion of NMIXX's latest work and target overseas markets with established fan bases, including Japan and Taiwan, by integrating entertainment content into the travel experience through boarding passes, cabin elements and the special-livery aircraft.

Under the currently announced plan, the NMIXX-themed HL8717 is expected to remain in service through April 30, 2027. Actual dates for the promotional elements and individual flight assignments may still change depending on Eastar Jet's operating requirements and fleet scheduling.
